entries.source: Nobody told Miss Sang to make a rosary. In 2015, she was a young woman living in Yiwu — a city that supplies the world's shelves, yet rarely pauses to ask what the things it makes might mean. She had been drawn to religious objects for years: their weight, their quiet symbolism, the way skilled hands could turn simple materials into something a stranger would hold during the hardest moments of their life.

entries.source: Stainless steel is used for chain, pins, jump rings, crosses, medals, and laser-cut components where durability and corrosion resistance are priorities. entries.source: Durability also depends on how the rosary is assembled. Nylon and polyester cord can provide strength and consistent color; cotton feels natural but can absorb moisture; waxed cord changes feel and knot behavior; elastic is convenient for bracelets but requires stretch-life testing. Metal-linked rosaries depend on wire gauge, eye-pin closure, jump-ring construction, chain material, and plating quality. Ask for pull testing or repeat-use testing when the application demands it.
entries.translation: Trajnost također ovisi o tome kako je krunica sastavljena. Najlonska i poliesterska vrpca mogu pružiti čvrstoću i dosljednu boju; pamuk djeluje prirodno, ali može upijati vlagu; voštana vrpca mijenja osjećaj i ponašanje čvorova; elastika je prikladna za narukvice, ali zahtijeva testiranje vijeka trajanja rastezanja. Krunice s metalnim vezama ovise o debljini žice, zatvaranju igle s ušicom, konstrukciji spojnih prstenova, materijalu lanca i kvaliteti oplata. Zatražite testiranje povlačenjem ili testiranje ponovljenom uporabom kada primjena to zahtijeva.

Requirements can differ for adult jewelry, children’s products, devotional objects, promotional gifts, and items sold in different countries.
